title: Manglefeet's Amazing Relic
description: Manglefeet's Amazing Relic — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Tilles the Sellout

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Collect 1 of Manglefeet's Amazing Atomic Elbow of the Year Relics from within Manglefeet's MutantMania and return to Tilles the Sellout.

Quest Reward: 20 King's Coins

Return to: Tilles the Sellout

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: Mutant Mania

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Collect 1 of Manglefeet's Amazing Atomic Elbow of the Year Relics from within Manglefeet's MutantMania and return to Tilles the Sellout.

Offer:

Private Buyer Looking for an Amazing Relic!
WANTED: 1 of Manglefeet's Amazing Atomic Elbow of the Year Relics. Looking for a certain something to make my wrestling ring pop. Contact Tilles the Sellout for more info.

Turn-in:

You have a knack for finding these Relics. I'll contact the person who posted the ad on your behalf.

Objectives:

  • Manglefeet's Amazing Relic ×1

Level range: 80–100
